top_titles.title: Rakh Bagh haveli का खौफ़नाक सच

winning_patterns: A specific, nameable place (fort, haveli, creek) people can search
A story/event angle ('The Night the Dam Broke') beats a label
avoid: Only 2 title templates ('X का खौफ़नाक सच 💀' / 'X: रात को मत जाना ⚠️') repeated on 48 Shorts - looks mass-produced
Truncated names ('Kanheri गुफ़ाs fores', 'Auto-rickshaw extra') - fixed in story_generator.py
Generic labels without a place ('इस वीरान जगह कभी मत जाना')
